en: A sepia-toned, antique-style illustration of a large Baroque or early-18th‑century palace with a formal geometric garden in the foreground. The main building has a long central block with a steep roof and a tall central spire, flanked by two lower wings or separate pavilions. In the garden, symmetrically arranged parterres, paths, and topiary are visible, with a few finely dressed figures strolling on the main walkway. The sky is filled with stylized, heavy clouds, typical of old engravings. There is no visible printed text on the image itself.
